explanation: RG01: forward the plan's declared memory limit to the build through the existing RSS watchdog (RLIMIT_AS would break sanitizer virtual memory) and short-circuit a build stopped by RSS/output-budget exhaustion as engine_failed/resource_exhaustion before any run or candidate decision. RG02: replace direct-file redirection with bounded pipe reads that enforce each stream's cap while consuming bytes (never overshooting the spool), stop a producer whose stream is capped, keep an EOF probe so an exactly-at-cap stream is not falsely truncated, drain late buffered bytes after exit without blocking on stray descendants, then digest/excerpt. Capped streams are marked truncated/inconclusive. All deadlines, budget claims, cancellation, process-group kill, cwd/env/stdin and other semantics are preserved.
